definitions.explanation: Being completely focused on one thing without any distraction; concentrating with one's entire heart and mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一心不乱|いっしんふらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{一心不乱|いっしんふらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}む→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧。
examples.english: To throw oneself wholeheartedly into work.

examples.japanese: {一心不乱|いっしんふらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けた→走り続ける：22070_hashiritsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: I kept running with complete focus.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
⟦{一心|いっしん}→一心：11236_isshin⟧ (one mind) + ⟦{不乱|ふらん}→不乱：noentry⟧ (not distracted)
Literally: "one mind, not scattered"

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally a Buddhist term describing a meditative state of complete concentration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一心不乱|いっしんふらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to work on wholeheartedly
- {一心不乱|いっしんふらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}む→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧: to devote oneself to
- {一心不乱|いっしんふらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make efforts wholeheartedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無我夢中|むがむちゅう}→無我夢中：05661_mugamuchuu⟧: being absorbed in
- ⟦{一途|いちず}→一途：18242_ichizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: single-mindedly
